description: This PHP class defines the 'CandidateVacancy' entity within the 'OrangeHRM' Human Resource Management system. It models the relationship between a candidate and a job vacancy, including properties such as ID, candidate reference, vacancy reference, application status, and application date. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes getter/setter methods for each property.

classes.name: CandidateVacancy
classes.description: Entity class representing a candidate's association with a job vacancy, including application details.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the CandidateVacancy entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the CandidateVacancy entity.

methods.name: getCandidate
methods.description: Returns the Candidate associated with this vacancy application.

methods.name: setCandidate
methods.description: Sets the Candidate associated with this vacancy application.

methods.name: getVacancy
methods.description: Returns the Vacancy associated with this application.

methods.name: setVacancy
methods.description: Sets the Vacancy associated with this application.

methods.name: getAppliedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the application was made.

methods.name: setAppliedDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the application was made.
